tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A warm off-white like a printed spec sheet. Never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs and anything that sits on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the primary button fill. 15.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, column headers. 6.6:1 on paper, 7.2:1 on panel. The lightest grey allowed for text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and row dividers. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Verified. Confirmed values, the adjusted result bar, links, focus ring. 7.4:1 on panel, so it works as text and as a fill under white text.

tokens.name: steel-tint
tokens.usage: Background for verified states and assumption pills. Steel text stays 6.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: gauge
tokens.usage: Needs a human look. Graphic use only: bars, chip borders, icons, cover blocks. Not for text; use gauge-ink for words.

tokens.name: gauge-ink
tokens.usage: Text for Check and red-flag states. Readable on panel and on gauge-tint.

tokens.name: gauge-tint
tokens.usage: Row and chip background for items that need review: Check values, red flags.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: Errors only: failed input, a request that could not be read. 7.1:1 on panel. Never used for a red flag, which is a question, not an error.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: nameplate
styles.usage: Screen titles and the one big verdict on Results. Set in uppercase. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Check each value against the proposal

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Paste the proposal your vendor sent.
styles.usage: Running text and form help. Keep lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text under inputs, captions. In ink-muted.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Every number the app reads or calculates. Always with its unit. Use tabular figures so columns line up.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, eyebrows, status words. Uppercase, like text stamped on an equipment nameplate.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip and its label, icon and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a field: label to input, input to helper text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between buttons, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page margins and the gap between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips and tags. Nearly square, like a printed label.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and cards. The largest radius in the system; nothing is pill-shaped except the step tracker.
